entities.name: Order's Citadel
entities.description: The primary city of the northern branch of the Order, in the Northern Plains of Otaria, built on a rocky hill.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: A faction with a northern branch whose griffins roost in the citadel courtyard.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land containing the Northern Plains where the citadel stands.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The 4305 AR conflict over the Mirari.

entities.name: Captain Pianna
entities.description: A captain who brings Laquatus and Turg to the citadel and is killed by Kirtar.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A character who intercepts the Mirari on the citadel roof.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: A character who helps Laquatus intercept the Mirari.

entities.name: Lieutenant Kirtar
entities.description: An aven officer who attacked the wildlife of Krosa and carries the Mirari; he withers away.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Trails the others in search of the Mirari and enters the citadel.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: An entrancing orb carried by Kirtar.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A land whose wildlife Kirtar attacked.

events.summary: Captain Pianna brings Laquatus and Turg to the citadel to witness the reprimand of Lieutenant Kirtar.
events.quote: Captain Pianna brought Laquatus and Turg to the Order's Citadel

events.summary: Kirtar encases Pianna in an expanding crystal, killing her, when she tries to destroy the Mirari.
events.quote: Kirtar encased her in an expanding crystal, killing her

events.summary: Kamahl enters the citadel amid mayhem and sees Kirtar carried away, but cannot reach the Mirari.
events.quote: He was unable to reach it due to the efforts of Laquatus and Turg

events.summary: Laquatus and Turg intercept the Mirari on the roof; Kirtar withers away and the crystal encases half the citadel.
events.quote: leaving Kirtar alone to wither away into nothing

relations.quote: Kirtar encased her in an expanding crystal, killing her

relations.note: In the Northern Plains of Otaria.
relations.quote: located in the Northern Plains of Otaria
